atoms.text: The gender gap describes a phenomenon where women and other gender identities are not equal to men in different domains. Most of the time women face disadvantages in comparison to men.

atoms.b: Although equal pay for equal work is ((++legally_mandated occasionally_optional rarely_discussed)), women still earn ((++less more equal)) than men on average and remain ((++underrepresented dominant indifferent)) in leadership roles due to barriers such as the “glass ceiling” and “old boy networks.”

In many faith communities, women face ((++disadvantages privileges exemptions)) both in access to positions of ((++authority entertainment inheritance)) and in the expectations placed upon them in their ((++private economic public)) lives.

Media often reinforces outdated gender ((++stereotypes freedoms balances)), portraying women as ((++objects leaders equals)) of sexual desire or as helpless figures who depend on ((++male_saviours female_friends social_workers)).

Because of ongoing economic ((++inequality prosperity stability)), society still frequently expects women to be the primary ((++caregivers earners competitors)) for children and elderly relatives. Even successful professional women face criticism that their careers come at the ((++expense benefit disregard)) of family life, while childless women are often viewed as ((++incomplete independent satisfied)).
Women and girls remain ((++disproportionately rarely equally)) affected by ((++domestic_abuse workplace_competition educational_barriers)) and gender-based violence.

atoms.a: Sarah and Jonathan work the exact same job, but Jonathan has the better salary.
The Catholic Church does not permit women to be ordained as priests, a stance rooted in the belief that Jesus chose only men as his apostles.
With regard to politics, headlines may highlight what a woman wore at a debate, while male candidates are asked about economic plans or foreign policy.
Since giving birth to her first child, Alma has been expected to stay at home instead of taking back up her own career.
Emma's grandmother told her that before their divorce her husband sometimes acted violent towards her.
